name: OpenFeedbackSection
description: A skill to open the user feedback section of the application.
precondition: User is on the main application page

execution_plan.fallback: Try to locate the feedback section button by its label
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the user feedback section is displayed

name: ReadVisibleInfo
description: Skill to read and extract visible numeric or dated information from the interface.
precondition: Information is visible on the screen.
success_predicate: Read visible numeric or dated information completed

execution_plan.fallback: Try to locate alternative information sources.
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the information has been successfully extracted.

name: HoverOverMenu
description: Skill to hover over a visible menu or expandable control.
success_predicate: Hover over the visible menu or expandable control. completed

execution_plan.target_desc: the menu or expandable control identified by menu_id
execution_plan.fallback: try to locate the menu by its label
execution_plan.success_check: verify that the menu is expanded or highlighted

name: UseSearchField
description: Interact with the visible search field to input a query.
precondition: The search field is visible and enabled.
success_predicate: Use the visible search field completed

execution_plan.fallback: click on the search field to focus
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the search field contains the input text

execution_plan.fallback: try clicking the search button again
execution_plan.success_check: Check if the search results are displayed

name: SubmitSearch
description: Submits a search query relevant to the current page.
precondition: User is on a page where search is relevant.
success_predicate: Submit a simple page-relevant search completed

execution_plan.fallback: try to locate the search input field by its placeholder
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the search input field contains the search_query

execution_plan.fallback: try to locate the submit button by its text
execution_plan.success_check: Check if the search results page is displayed
